item.title: Suspected Iran Cyberattacks on U.S. Water Supply Follow Years of Warnings and Neglect
item.description: Federal and state officials are racing to address an assault on the nation’s water supply that they believe is the work of Iranian hackers.

item.category: US and Israeli Attack on Iran (2026)

item.title: El-Sayed’s Michigan Senate Primary Win Sets Up the Left’s Biggest Test of the Fall

item.title: Takeaways From the Primary Elections in Michigan
item.description: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed narrowly prevailed over Representative Haley Stevens in the Democratic primary for Senate in Michigan, setting up a nervy race to November for the party.

item.media:description: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed’s close primary victory signaled that he has work to do to unite Democrats and turn out swing voters in November.
